text:
jen: quick sync — customer X wants a fast path into the edge canary for 12 tenants. they want opt-in today; asks: skiplist specific tenants, A/B on prompt templates, and a tighter rollback window. can we scope this?

ajay: do we mean edge routing (region-level) or dedicated edge nodes?

rachel: they asked for edge routing to avoid extra hop. implies different routing policy + quick fallback to regional pools.

sree: main risks: cold kv-cache for new tenants, token cost bump if sampling is wrong, and telemetry is sparse for edge slice.

carl: agree — need a kill-switch per-tenant + global circuit breaker. also: quota guards so runaway embeddings don't spike cost.

jen: propose minimal scope for today: 1) per-tenant skiplist table 2) sample 5% traffic to variant B (prompt tweak) 3) attach explicit kill-switch and reason logging 4) telemetry hooks for latency & token delta.

ajay: ok. quick config sketch:
```
feature_flag: edge_canary_v3
rules:
  - condition: tenant in ["acct-123","acct-456"]
    action: route: edge
  - condition: tenant in skiplist
    action: route: regional
sampling: 0.05  # variant B
kill_switch: /api/flags/edge_canary_v3/kill
```

rachel: sampling at 5% seems fine, but we should have sequential ramp plan: 5% -> 20% -> 50% over 24h with checks. add telemetry check at each step: 95p latency, token per request, model error rate.

sree: telemetry checks: add a short eval suite for prompt quality (we can run the first 500 responses through simple heuristics). if quality drops > 3% we auto-fallback.

carl: operational note — need a short TTL on KV cache priming for these tenants so we don't ship stale prefixes. maybe prime with a background warmup job.

jen: customer wants quicker opt-in. tradeoffs: faster opt-in -> higher blast radius. propose a compromise: allow customer to request "fast opt" but require SRE on-call and 1-hr guarded ramp with manual approvals at each step.

ajay: manual approval flow doable. deploy-bot will timestamp approvals.

deploy-bot: approval requested by jen for acct-123 fast-opt. status: pending.

rachel: operational checklist for fast-opt: 1) add tenants to skiplist 2) enable sampling 5% 3) start kv-warmup 4) attach telemetry dashboard 5) SRE approve -> proceed.

sree: add fallback policy: primary fallback -> regional model variant; secondary fallback -> lower-cost model + notify customer; final -> 503 with graceful message.

carl: also add cost gating: if token spend delta > 2x baseline in first 2h, auto-stepdown to 1% or off.

jen: next steps: @ajay can you wire the kill-switch + approval endpoint? @rachel set up dashboard + the small eval job. @sree write the fallback auto-fallback rules. i'll coordinate with customer ops for manual approvals.

ajay: will do. ETA 3h for kill-switch + endpoint.
rachel: dashboard and eval job in ~5h.
sree: will draft auto-fallback rules and thresholds today.

jen: thanks — we'll reconvene in #product in 6h for go/no-go. :thumbsup:
